description: This file defines a Java class for a business event related to loan transaction adjustments in the Apache Fineract project. It models an event that encapsulates details about adjusting a loan transaction, extending from an abstract business event class, and includes nested data class with transaction details.

classes.name: LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a business event for adjusting a loan transaction, extending the AbstractBusinessEvent class and specifying event type and category.

classes.name: LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEvent.Data
classes.description: Nested static class holding the details of the transaction to be adjusted and the new transaction details, with getter and setter annotations.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for the event, 'LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEvent'.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the event, 'Loan'.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the loan associated with the transaction to adjust, serving as the aggregate root ID.

methods.name: LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEvent(Data value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with specific data.
